configuration: Initial Alpha-Service runtime with task dispatch, visual trigger/streaming models, web search, and JSON memory.
sources_read: https://arxiv.org/html/2510.14359v1 — version 2510.14359v1, sections 1–7 and appendices A–B

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: User dialogue information is automatically extracted after interactions and retained in JSON memory.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Retrieved interaction history informs the orchestrator’s response synthesis.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: The orchestrator activates future-timing triggers and requests finer visual analysis according to task needs.

M->S.label: insufficient
M->S.rationale: Response-time retrieval is described; supplying retained priors directly to perceptual sampling or interpretation is not established.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Episode records retain the assistant’s output for subsequent retrieval.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: Persistent episode memory records delivered assistance.
record.quote: the agent’s final output, a unique timestamp

outcome.label: not_stated
outcome.rationale: Dialogue retention does not explicitly establish retained subsequent feedback or results concerning assistance.

attribution.label: not_stated
attribution.rationale: No outcome-linked checking or correction of assistance is described.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Retrieved episode content changes context; no service-authored durable change to parameters, prompts, rules, or code is described.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: The demonstrations do not report execution under a service-revised mechanism.

notes: Independent text-only review of the named initial implementation. No repository was supplied. Conceptual aspirations and future work were excluded.
